verdict.rationale: Visa ships an official TypeScript Agent Toolkit that integrates with the Vercel AI SDK or runs as an MCP server, and it is published on npm as @visaacceptance/mcp by Visa maintainers. However, the toolkit's documented scope is Pay by Link and Invoicing. The core Intelligent Commerce APIs (card enrollment, purchase-intent instructions, credential retrieval) are documented only as raw REST endpoints. The Trusted Agent Protocol offers a reference implementation and code snippets rather than a packaged SDK. Missing for 10: an official multi-language SDK covering the Intelligent Commerce token, instruction and credential APIs; SDK reference docs; a packaged TAP signing/verification library; independent hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
